# ETF průvodce.cz

> Czech website about ETF funds for Czech investors. Its focus: how much an investor actually earns in Czech crowns (CZK) – fund returns are converted to CZK with Czech National Bank exchange rates. Fund data (5,100+ UCITS ETFs and ETCs) are updated daily; every figure shows the date it refers to.

## Main sections

- Homepage: https://etfpruvodce.cz/
- ETF screener (filter and compare all funds, returns in CZK): https://etfpruvodce.cz/srovnani
- ETF rankings by category, index and theme: https://etfpruvodce.cz/zebricky
- Portfolio backtest on historical data in CZK: https://etfpruvodce.cz/backtest
- Data-driven answers for investors (returns in CZK, currency risk, lump sum vs. DCA, accumulating vs. distributing): https://etfpruvodce.cz/co-rikaji-data
- Model portfolios: https://etfpruvodce.cz/portfolio-strategie
- Calculators: https://etfpruvodce.cz/kalkulacky
- Where to buy ETFs (broker comparison): https://etfpruvodce.cz/kde-koupit
- ETF basics guide: https://etfpruvodce.cz/pruvodce
- Taxes on ETFs in the Czech Republic: https://etfpruvodce.cz/dane-z-etf

## ETF detail pages

Pattern: https://etfpruvodce.cz/etf/{ISIN}

- https://etfpruvodce.cz/etf/IE00B4L5Y983 (iShares Core MSCI World)
- https://etfpruvodce.cz/etf/IE00B5BMR087 (iShares Core S&P 500)
- https://etfpruvodce.cz/etf/IE00BK5BQT80 (Vanguard FTSE All-World)

## ETF comparisons

Pattern: https://etfpruvodce.cz/srovnani/{ticker1}-vs-{ticker2}

- https://etfpruvodce.cz/srovnani/vwce-vs-cspx
- https://etfpruvodce.cz/srovnani/vwce-vs-iwda
- https://etfpruvodce.cz/srovnani/cspx-vs-vuaa

## Data and method

- Fund data (TER, size, returns in EUR): scraped daily from justETF; returns in CZK and USD are converted with CNB/ECB exchange rates.
- Backtests use index histories with month-end or daily data, converted to CZK per day.
- Returns are after fund fees (TER), before taxes and broker fees.
